learner.initialization: kaiming_uniform_(a=sqrt(5)) for weights, uniform(-1/sqrt(fan_in), 1/sqrt(fan_in)) for bias

m_channel_definitions.B_perm: M_T mapped through global fixed spatial permutation
m_channel_definitions.mu_D: a_X / |D| if s in deduplicated D else 0
m_channel_definitions.mu_T: a_X / |T| if s in deduplicated T else 0
m_channel_definitions.orientation: spatial_row_col: row 0 = rank 8, col 0 = file a

outcome_logic.aulc_rules: fail-closed on non-finite U, mismatched lengths, non-strict budgets

p_numeric_encoding.orientation: spatial_row_col: row 0 = rank 8, col 0 = file a

seed.aggregation: mean seed root NLL across 5 seeds BEFORE computing root inference or AULC

source_evidence.eligibility_rule: >=2 finite SOURCE CP alternatives, determined before TARGET

split.key_definition: JSON serialization of board_arrangement_fen, castling_rights, en_passant_square, side_to_move

target_labels.attrition_training: Nominal selected training roots with 0 TARGET-evaluable pairs contribute 0 training examples, are not replaced, consume no minibatch slot.
target_labels.attrition_val_test: Roots must have >=1 TARGET-evaluable pair. Exact identical root set across all representations and budgets.
target_labels.semantics: Inherited CompareTyped. Typed mate observations remain typed and ordered if CompareTyped allows. Not blindly excluded.
